name: zomato-clone
description: Zomato clone — home page (React) + Node.js TypeScript backend

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm --dir backend dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
